statement: Community HID notes define input 0x30 as report ID, timer at byte 1, battery/connection at byte 2, buttons at 3-5, packed 12-bit sticks at 6-11, vibrator feedback byte 12, and three six-axis IMU sample frames at bytes 13-48 (accelerometer then gyro, signed little-endian). Subcommand 0x03 selects full report mode 0x30.
